description: Get the open jobs of specific companies straight from the employer's own applicant tracking system (Workday, Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, Workable, SmartRecruiters, Recruitee, Personio, Teamtailor), looked up by company name, domain or careers-page URL, in one uniform schema, with a monitor mode that returns only newly posted jobs, and keyword search (no company list) over a daily index of ~730,000 jobs from ~15,700 company boards. Routes to jordan-belfort/ats-jobs-api and jordan-belfort/workday-jobs-scraper (1,447 Workday companies by name). Use when someone asks what NVIDIA, Stripe or Notion is hiring for, open roles at a list of companies, new postings since yesterday, hiring signals for sales or recruiting, a Workday, Greenhouse, Lever or Personio jobs API, to track a company's careers page, or to search jobs by title straight from employers' boards. Not for LinkedIn or Indeed listings. $0.001 per job returned.

semanticRubric.prompt: Did the agent validate API outcomes instead of assuming success?
Did the agent preserve evidence for request/response behavior and error handling?
